codeRefs.standardId: AISI specification for design of cold-formed steel structural members

dataStatus: External table reference only; zero capacity cells imported.
loadBasis: Manufacturer identifies ASD; beam table values are total uniformly distributed loads on a simple beam, not load per unit length.
conditions: Manufacturer states carbon steel and stainless steel applicability; not aluminum.
Source states steel cold formed from 33 ksi to 42 ksi.
Beam table includes lateral-bracing factors and deflection limits; column tables distinguish load at slot face from centroid loading and effective-length factors.
blockers: Reuse rights for numerical table not established.
2007 source-table basis must not be silently relabeled to a newer standard.
Stainless material-specific performance cautions must be resolved with manufacturer before use.
